title: Genomic Landscape of Gastroenteropancreatic Neuroendocrine Neoplasms Using Panel Sequencing.
snippet: The clinical utility of genomic profiling in gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms (GEP-NENs) remains incompletely defined, particularly for clinically relevant annotated alterations and prognostic stratification. title: Single-Cell Sequencing of Diffuse Midline Glioma Reveals That CTHRC1 Promotes Tumor Malignant Progression via the Wnt/β-Catenin/MMP2 Signaling Pathway.
snippet: Despite the continuous advancement of neurosurgical techniques and the accelerated pace of drug development, the prognosis of diffuse midline glioma (DMG) remains unsatisfactory.
